description: Search the web and get LLM-ready Markdown. Each result has its title, URL and only the passages relevant to the query (cross-encoder pruned context), so it costs far fewer tokens than raw pages. Use for current events, documentation, APIs, research and fact checking.

category.description: Focus on one kind of page: company, research paper, news, pdf, github, personal site, linkedin profile, financial report, people.

country.description: Two-letter country code (US, DE): that country's results rank higher.

end_published_date.description: Only pages published on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

exclude_domains.description: Never return results from these domains.

include_domains.description: Only return results from these domains, e.g. ["docs.python.org"].

language.description: Two-letter language code (en, de): results in that language rank higher.

num_results.description: Number of results to return (1-25, default 5).

start_published_date.description: Only pages published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Undated pages are dropped.

time_range.description: Only pages published in the last day, week, month or year.

topic.description: news: news sources, recent pages first. finance: SEC filings and finance sites. Default general.

name: contextfetch_search
title: ContextFetch web search
